Metadata.description: School management for administrators, teachers, students and parents.

Landing.badge: One platform for your whole school
Landing.description: Classes, courses, timetables and the school calendar in one place, kept up to date for administrators, teachers, students and parents.
Landing.featuresSubtitle: Set up your school once, and everyone sees a schedule that stays current.

classes.title: Classes and courses
classes.text: Create classes, enrol students and give each course a teacher, a weekly schedule and the dates it runs.

timetable.title: Personal timetables
timetable.text: Teachers, students and parents see their own lessons by day, week or month, with a marker for right now.

timeline.title: School-wide timeline
timeline.text: Admins see every course and lesson across the year, grouped by class or teacher, and can zoom from a term down to a day.

calendar.title: School calendar
calendar.text: Exams, trips and parents' meetings for the school or one class. Public holidays are added for you and cancel that day's lessons.

people.title: Invitations and roles
people.text: Invite teachers, students and parents by email. Each person sees only what their role allows.

health.title: Overview and monitoring
health.text: Live numbers for your school, and a log of errors and slow requests so problems get noticed.

admin.title: School admins
admin.text: Set up classes, courses and schedules, manage people and plan the calendar.

teacher.title: Teachers
teacher.text: See your timetable and your classes, and invite your students.

student.title: Students
student.text: Know what's next today, this week and this month.

parent.title: Parents
parent.text: Follow your child's timetable and the school's events.
